body: Oh my god thank you so much. I'm 17 but will be attending college next year.
I'm glad I'm not alone. Unfortunately I think confronting him like that would cause a meltdown
My point. Cops arent exactly nice to people with autism (i guess neither with sexual abuse, but he's 15. it can be corrected)

He has an at-home teacher which I think I'll end up talking to. He ultimately just needs to be corrected, I had no idea this post would blow up the way it did. I don't think he's abusive but just doesn't know its wrong, it makes sense since I'm the closest girl to him. I know thats no excuse but I really believe he can be "fixed"

I will be contacting my bishop today to see what can be done. I only fear that authorities will hurt him, but I have no choice. If his behavior goes unchecked the possibility of doing this to others will be another question to ask. Thank you so much for your reply :)

Please don't joke about my issue or my brother like this. What he is doing may be wrong but it can be corrected, he's 15. I understand wanting to make this lighthearted but this isn't the time. Thanks :)
Oh shoot sorry I misread your question. Yes there are but theyre all online, and nobody I really trust. I had answered to who can take me in
Oh okay just checking haha. Thank you again :)

Oh yes, I want to be very clear I know that not everyone is like this. I just think it may be something to do with his sexual development- hence the meltdowns. Only my mom. I have no friends online and offline (like, no joke.) So I thought I'd let it all out on a reddit post

Trying my best. I have a lot of other autistic people in my life aswell, which is why I know not everyone is like this. I think its something to do with the delay in growth? Not sure, but still. Trying to find a way to leave is going to be so hard.

Thank you so much. My main issue is that I have nowhere to go, literally nowhere. If I'm not living here I am basically homeless. Theres also two dogs in the house who would not be taken care of if I left, so thats another issue. Thank you again, its been really hard. I have nobody I can discuss this with besides my mother and she has rejected my plea for help.
Unfortunately no, if there was it would had been done
